title: 5 things you should know about High NA EUV lithography

passages.note: Opening, Larger, anamorphic optics for sharper imaging, and Commonality and modularity for better performance. ASML reports shipping the first modules of the first EXE:5000 to Intel from Veldhoven in December 2023. The platform reused parts of existing EUV technology while adopting new optics and stages.
